scope: Exact primary comparison of multicast/shared-source movement, partial independent destination WRITE permission, and finite receive-buffer admission. No implementation or model.

verdict.positive: 已核primary有共享/复制数据、译址权限、有限缓冲、逐输出消费标记等组件；本次未读到把不同消费者部分WRITE前缀Ci与真实独占容量Qi联合为不可撤源AR整段准入的准确算法。
verdict.limits: 这是实际已读范围内的覆盖裁决，不是搜索未命中即首创，也不能从Intel架构规范推断其内部没有同样准入。
verdict.action: 保留完整权限/容量边界为具体架构候选；shared READ、multicast、消费mask、private FIFO或通用credit不能分别算独立贡献。
verdict.next_gate: 在相同source READ许可、原生prepare/TC接口、Qi、W/B端口和真实return storage预算下，核普通逐拍fork+buffer、源按授权公共前缀分片、整段提前准备的具体能力和总成本；若同信息同预算普通控制已完整复现，不能将本公式作为独有调度收益。

contract_compared.source: 冻结K个接收者；每个接收者自己的READ访问已成功授权整个源范围。不同接收者的源虚拟地址必须被核为兼容同一物理源数据/属性；一个issuer的权限不能替代别的接收者权限。
contract_compared.prepare: Ci为各自连续可写目的范围，且授权结果在物理真实写/B结算期间可合法保留。只把authorized且fully resident范围提交物理AW。
contract_compared.capacity: Qi是该次accepted source envelope可独占的实际返回容量；既有占用、其他accepted AR承诺、byte-mask、上游return spill全部按真实生命周期计。不能把总物理容量当本次free容量。
contract_compared.source_admission: N <= min_i(Ci + Qi)，before first irreversible ARVALID；每个suffix max(0,N-Ci)都进入各自private buffer，待自己的WRITE许可后提交。
contract_compared.liveness: 授权prefix能不依赖下一WRITE page walk独立排空；共享返回路径不能被待许可suffix堵住后再堵PTE。持久物理fault另需错误/恢复协议。
contract_compared.native_geometry: N256/source0x800、dest253+3或252+4仅decouple_rw=1且deburst=0；当前production RAW_COUPLING_AVAIL=0。启用first-R/AW耦合须显式multi-original-AW release，不假造多次首R。

exact_primary.work: Intel Data Streaming Accelerator Architecture Specification, revision 3.0
exact_primary.covered: Two destinations are an existing copy operation. Both destination offsets must agree in bits11:0. On partial completion from a page fault, both destinations have equal written-byte progress. ATS returns effective access permissions; BOF blocks or stops/reports partial completion. Finite read buffers have group Reserved/Allowed controls.
exact_primary.uncovered_by_read: No inspected passage specifies per-recipient private payload capacity, partial WRITE-coverage credits, exact source-burst admission, or independently advanced destination write progress during a blocked operation.
exact_primary.actual_difference: Arbitrary differing destination page offsets and independently advancing prepared prefixes are outside this dualcast API contract. This is an interface capability difference, not evidence its unpublished microarchitecture lacks C+Q.
exact_primary.caveat: The spec defines copying one source to two destinations, but the inspected dualcast passage alone does not guarantee exactly one physical source fetch. This source also does not establish independent per-recipient PASID/READ rights.

exact_primary.work: Torrent: A Distributed DMA for Efficient and Flexible Point-to-Multipoint Data Movement, arXiv2512.17589v1
exact_primary.decisive_read: §III-A–C, HTMLlines123–143; §IV-C lines216–220. Local code snippets below personally read, not README-only inference.
exact_primary.covered: Torrent constructs a destination chain. Backward grants precede payload; each intermediate node replicates to its local writer and next hop. It supports differing destination geometry. Its published zero-temporary-copying claim does not establish zero end-to-end buffering.

source_decision.fact: Splitter stores per-output consumed flags, allowing one output to accept a beat first without duplicate acceptance. Input advances only after all selected outputs accept; payload remains at input.
Outputs connect to local writer and next-hop stream; readiness/grant metadata derives from writerBusy, not a destination-permission frontier.
Middle node waits for downstream grant, then grants upstream; grant VALID is retained until actual handshake.
Remote data W acceptance is gated by grant and data availability.

exact_primary.unknown: Not inspected: complete Reader/Writer buffering, external IOMMU integration, any permission-aware extension. No claim entire Torrent has zero buffers or cannot be adapted.

division_of_work.dma_latte: Root is directly reading latest arXiv2511.06605v3 and AMDResearch/AMD-DMA-Latte. This seat avoids duplicating that evidence. Preliminary v1 read is not used to judge latest implementation.
division_of_work.no_classical_extra: The exact Intel dualcast+translation+read-buffer specification is a closer concrete comparator than another generic multicast/credit paper. No broad paper map reopened.

concrete_countercontrol.name: same-resource consume-mask fork plus ordinary shared source splitting
concrete_countercontrol.ancestry: Actual Torrent SplitterDecoupled supplies the consume-mask primitive; actual current iDMA coupled-boundary legalizer supplies shared read/write boundary splitting. This combined comparison is explicitly an engineered control, not falsely attributed as a published complete permission-frontier implementation.
complete_policy: Freeze the same K recipients and validate each own source READ; retain destination preparations with the same certificates/interface lifetime as candidate.
Choose common source AR length M no larger than the smallest continuous prepared destination prefix, and normal AXI source boundary; no source bytes outside prepared WRITE coverage in this control.
Fan each accepted beat into the same reserved Qi private FIFO per recipient using per-output consumed flags. Pop source beat only after every selected FIFO accepted; no extra shared payload history.
Drain each recipient independently through the same fully resident authorized physical-WRITE child policy; account all actual child WLAST/Bs; one original logical completion per recipient.
Translate remaining destination pages and repeat source read from the next offset. No re-fetch of completed bytes and no fake owner release.

Alternative complete control: prepare each entire candidate envelope first, then perform the same single shared AR and fanout; this matches long-read source traffic but charges preparation delay/storage and retained permission state.
concrete_countercontrol.capability_witness: If all Ci<N but every N-Ci<=Qi, this conservative split control cannot launch length N immediately; candidate may launch N and finish that shared source R without awaiting extra WRITE translations. This establishes a permitted action difference from this exact control, not an end-to-end speedup or optimality theorem.
concrete_countercontrol.strongest_remaining_question: An ordinary fork with backpressure and the same Qi might already safely launch N for a particular geometry without explicit C+Q logic. Must trace real return/PTW path and all capacity reservations; if it realizes every candidate action under the same contractual guarantee, the proposed admission has no unique behavioral contribution.
concrete_countercontrol.fair_cost: Candidate earns no free prepare/PA bypass, consumed masks, originalB aggregation, exclusive Qi, invalidate/error handling, multi-AW permit, or source-read-result retention.

cannot_claim: 因为DSA和DMA-Latte已有一源多目的操作，不能把少一次重复源读本身当独立创新。
因为Torrent原码已有逐输出接收标记，不能把不同接收者在不同cycle消费同拍当独立创新。
因为通用credit只能证明空间可收、WRITE证书只证明合法可写，二者单独均是组件；加IOMMU名称或重命名字段不能形成贡献。
DSA低12位限制仅区别其API；Torrent已经允许不同目的几何，故任意offset本身也不能成为本文贡献。
innovation_conditions.could_claim_if: 如果在真实共享R/PTW返回路径、独立WRITE许可与完整源READ权下，联合prefix+reserved suffix合同增加强普通同预算无法保证的合法长读动作，且给出完整可实现反馈/错误/失效接口与性能或成本差，就可以把这项跨翻译/数据的准入能力作为独立架构贡献；primary覆盖仍需继续由确切算法裁决。
real_limitations: 首批限制冻结接收者；晚加入/退出须新的授权与capacity原子合同。
最大安全段由最紧消费者决定；弱目的可降低所有消费者的source envelope。
无WRITE授权的payload只在device private buffer中保留；禁止越权内存写。
普通TLB miss、权限检查失败、invalidations和真实page-fault恢复是不同情况；永久WRITE故障不能靠容量公式保证job完成。
实际上游spill改变Qi；abstract U>Q stall不能冒称当前board死锁。
当前production512-word FIFO的flow不会因3-word研究假设自动收益。
